title: Upload
subtitle: Bring work from your computer into Heimdall as a zip file. Pick what kind of zip it is.

help.runs: Results of comparisons you ran on your own computer. Heimdall checks they were not changed after the run; anything that fails this check is refused.
help.project: Your agents, benchmarks, comparisons and release rules (folders agents/, benchmarks/, experiments/, policies/). Files are added; old versions are kept.
help.agent: One agent's folder. It is saved in agents/<name>/. Leave the name empty to use the zip's folder name.

drop.tooLarge: This zip is larger than {{mb}} MiB; split it into several zips.

failed: Upload failed. Check the zip and try again.

runs.empty: The zip had no comparison folder. To upload agents or benchmarks, pick the Project folder tab instead.

cards.runs: Results you ran on your own computer
